external_entities.description: A backend operated by another product team that calls the inference gateway.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Other teams' backends call our inference gateway
external_entities.notes: The description says there are two calling services in a different cloud, but gives no words to distinguish them; they are represented as one generic calling service.

external_entities.name: ML engineers
external_entities.description: Engineers who publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket.
external_entities.source_excerpt: ML engineers publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket.
external_entities.notes: The description is uncertain about what governs who can push and says it may be a shared group account.

processes.name: Inference gateway
processes.description: A FastAPI service that receives inference requests and forwards them to the model server.
processes.source_excerpt: our inference gateway, a FastAPI service on GKE

processes.name: Model server
processes.description: The server that runs the actual model and reads model artifacts and customer features.
processes.source_excerpt: the model server, which runs the actual model on GPU nodes in our model network
processes.notes: The model server uses its own service account to load artifacts. The description says artifact verification is not believed to occur: "I don't believe anything verifies the artifact hasn't been swapped — we just trust the bucket."

data_stores.name: Model registry bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket containing model artifacts loaded by the model server at startup.
data_stores.notes: The description says artifact integrity verification is uncertain: "I don't believe anything verifies the artifact hasn't been swapped — we just trust the bucket."

data_stores.name: Redis feature store
data_stores.description: A Redis store containing customer features such as account age and spend bands per customer.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a Redis feature store on the same network
data_stores.notes: Redis has no password and is only reachable inside the model network.

data_stores.name: Inference log
data_stores.description: A BigQuery log containing every request and response for debugging, including raw prompts.
data_stores.source_excerpt: an inference log in BigQuery, for debugging
data_stores.notes: The log contains raw prompts, which sometimes carry whatever the calling team's users typed.

data_flows.name: call inference gateway
data_flows.description: A calling service sends an inference request to the inference gateway.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Other teams' backends call our inference gateway
data_flows.notes: Callers pass an API key in a header. Keys are issued per calling team and have never been expired.

data_flows.name: forward request
data_flows.description: The inference gateway forwards an inference request to the model server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The gateway forwards the request to the model server
data_flows.notes: There is no authentication between the gateway and the model server.

data_flows.name: load model artifacts
data_flows.description: The model server loads model artifacts from the registry bucket at startup.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The model server loads model artifacts from a model registry bucket at startup.

data_flows.notes: Redis has no password on it.

data_flows.name: write inference log
data_flows.description: The inference gateway writes every request and response to the inference log.

data_flows.data_description: every request and response, including raw prompts

data_flows.source_excerpt: ML engineers publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket.
data_flows.notes: The description says: "I'm not sure what governs who can push — I think it is a shared group account." This is a voiced uncertainty, so authentication remains unknown.

trust_boundaries.description: The network containing the model server and Redis feature store; it is intended to be reachable only from the inference gateway.

trust_boundaries.notes: The model network is described as only reachable from the gateway.
